```yaml
name: Lychee

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lychee:
    name: Lychee
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run lychee
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v1.10.0
        with:
          fail: true
          args: --verbose --no-progress './**/*.md'
```
